description: The ILU software catalogue identifies gtfs2osm as a Python tool providing road-network projection facilities using GTFS and OpenStreetMap. It records the tool as developed by the bus-network optimization paper and its related thesis, separately from the busOpt optimization repository. Public GitHub metadata confirms the distinct CronoPT/gtfs_to_osm repository and describes work on the CARRIS network in Lisbon. This source-established preparation function supports transport model construction; no separate optimization engine or additional simulation functions are inferred. The catalogue labels the software GNU General Public without a version, while GitHub detects no licence. Exact reuse terms remain unresolved. Code is publicly visible, but was not downloaded or executed. Geographic coverage beyond the Lisbon application, input schemas, installation dependencies, output structure and performance limits are not established by the inspected metadata.
